title: Keel: A Frontier Model Teaches a Vision-Language Model by Rewriting Its Weights
abstract: arXiv:2611.25257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a frontier model repair a vision-language model (VLM) by rewriting its weights? Small reasoning VLMs such as Qwen3.5 need such a repair: in thinking mode they fall into loops on many image questions, repeating themselves until the token limit, spending the whole budget and losing the answer. The usual remedies act on the decoding, leaving the looping model as it was, or must be told what to change. Yet the cause is written in the weights. Keel, the first agentic weight-editing method for VLMs on image tasks, finds and removes it there. Told only the symptom, an editor, a frontier multimodal LLM acting as an agent, locates the cause, edits the weights and tests them, with a failure census and instruments showing it the failing images and where the VLM attends; among several editors, the harness keeps only edits that clearly reduce the failure without lowering accuracy on questions no editor saw. translated_title: Keel：一个前沿模型通过重写权重来教导视觉-语言模型
translated_abstract: 前沿模型能否通过重写权重来修复一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）？诸如Qwen3.5这样的小型推理VLM正需要这样的修复：在思考模式下，它们会在许多图像问题上陷入循环，不断重复自己直至达到token上限，耗尽全部预算并丢失答案。通常的补救措施只作用于解码过程，让陷入循环的模型保持原样，或者必须被告知该修改什么。然而，病因就写在权重之中。Keel是首个面向图像任务的VLM代理式权重编辑方法，它直接在权重中找到并消除病因。只需被告知症状，一个编辑器——作为代理运行的前沿多模态大语言模型——便会定位病因、编辑权重并进行测试，失败普查和检测工具会向它展示失败的图像以及VLM的注意力所在；在多个编辑器之中，该框架只保留那些能明显减少失败、且不会降低编辑器未见问题上准确率的修改。这种修复无需任何训练，并能保持……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Keel提出首个面向VLM图像任务的代理式权重编辑方法，让前沿多模态大语言模型作为代理，仅凭症状描述即可定位、修改并验证模型权重，无需训练就能修复小型推理VLM在思考模式下的循环失败，且不损害未见问题上的准确率。
en_tdlr: Keel introduces the first agentic weight-editing method for VLMs on image tasks, where a frontier multimodal LLM acts as an agent to locate, edit, and test the model's weights from symptom descriptions alone, fixing the looping failures of small reasoning VLMs in thinking mode without any training or loss of accuracy on unseen questions.
